overview.description: The GraniteShares 2x Long VRT Daily ETF (VRTL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in industrials equity. The fund provides 2x leveraged exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement for shares of Vertiv Holdings Co. (VRT) stock. VRTL was launched on Mar 25, 2025 and is issued by GraniteShares.
